Sanjay, a wealthy family's son and fellow UPSC aspirant, falls in love with Paragi and supports her dream. Paragi clears the exam, but Sanjay fails, putting their impending marriage at risk and testing their love.

programme.title: Christmas Comes Home
programme.desc: A widower falls for his son's physical rehabilitation specialist.

programme.title: Merry Kiss Cam
programme.desc: 2022 Festive romcom with Katie Lowes. She's an artist, he's a sports-mad bartender. When their kiss on the Kiss Cam brings their hockey team good luck, fans want them to keep the magic going.

programme.title: Holiday Wish Come True
programme.desc: Two sisters' only wish is to spend the holidays as a family, forcing their divorced parents to work out their issues and find love again. Starring Schuyler Fisk 2018

programme.title: Holiday Date
programme.desc: 2019 Romance with Brittany Bristow. When a woman is dumped before the holidays, a charming actor plays the part of her boyfriend perfectly at a family gathering - but is it really just make-believe?

programme.title: The Nine Lives Of Christmas
programme.desc: 2014 Festive romance with Brandon Routh and Kimberley Sustad. A committed bachelor and a busy vet student have no time for love. But will the arrival of a stray tabby lead to the purr-fect romance?

programme.title: Christmas Wedding Planner
programme.desc: 2017 Romantic drama with Jocelyn Hudon. A woman is hired to plan her cousin's elaborate wedding and things are going perfectly - until a handsome stranger arrives asking questions about the groom.

programme.title: Christmas by The Book
programme.desc: A bestselling writer is dispatched by a TV talk show to a rural town where she is given two weeks to re-create the magical childhood Christmas described in her book. Starring Lindy Booth 2022

programme.title: Christmas Unwrapped
programme.desc: A reporter investigates a man who insists that all of the Christmas gifts his charity gives are magically supplied by Santa Claus. Starring Amber Stevens West 2020

programme.title: Jingle Around the Clock
programme.desc: 2018 Holly-jolly rom-com starring Brooke Nevin. An ad exec's Christmas dreams take a turn when she's forced to team up with her rival on a career-altering project.

programme.title: CHRISTMAS LOVE LETTER
programme.desc: 2019 Intriguing Christmas romance with Ashley Newbrough. A relationship advice columnist receives an unsigned love letter. But as she hunts for the mystery writer, can she also find true love?

programme.title: Christmas in Toyland
programme.desc: 2022 Festive rom-com with Vanessa Lengies. Data analyst Charlie is sent to a thriving toy shop to replicate its formula. Can manager Grant's secrets to success open her mind... and heart?

programme.title: Christmas on Honeysuckle Lane
programme.desc: After her parents' death, Emma returns home to celebrate Christmas for the last time with her siblings in the house they grew up in. Starring Alicia Witt 2018

programme.title: Twinkle All The Way
programme.desc: 2019 Festive romance with Sarah Drew. Two single parents find themselves growing closer as they juggle a wedding and a VIP Christmas Eve party, discovering love in unexpected places.

programme.title: Northpole 2: Open For Christmas
programme.desc: 2015 Christmas drama starring Tiffani Thiessen. When a mum inherits a magical hotel, Santa sends an eager elf to lend a hand - and maybe sprinkle a little holiday magic along the way.

programme.title: Dashing Home For Christmas
programme.desc: 2020 Festive rom com with Paniz Zade and Adrian Spencer. Every possible obstacle is trying to stop Emily getting home for Christmas. Can teaming up with fellow traveller Simon get her back in time?

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: 2016 Family drama with Erin Krakow and Niall Matter. Miranda never knew who her father was, but when she finds a clue about his identity, will this Christmas deliver what she's always longed for?
